claim_ceiling: Certificates are exact only for the frozen 1 MiB, Threads=1, warmed-TT, 80k-node measurement procedure and address-trigger semantics.
Inclusion-minimal means replay-certified 1-minimal within the searched event universe, not globally minimum-cardinality and not unique causation.
A sufficient retaining set is sufficient only relative to its frozen frontier-null intervention and support world.
Targets that become unreachable after an intervention are not remapped; reachability is part of the counterfactual.
Baseline-address incompleteness under path divergence is not converted into a no-cause conclusion.
Chess language is certificate-bounded and may not exceed mechanically verified move/PV facts.
No prevalence or cross-position generalization beyond the selected P31 root-dependent support is authorized.
